task: Diagnose repeated generic calls failing in Fast Debug after exact ReturnValue authority checks were introduced.
observation: The repeated identity call had an exact checker-published specialization_result on its EST call node (ExprId 6), but the call evaluator did not pass that ExprId into call specialization selection. The callee frame consequently had an empty specialization key and could not find its exact ReturnValue fact. Threading the EST occurrence through restored selection without runtime-value inference.
impact: A previously green Phase 27.5.1 parity gate failed until the exact call occurrence was retained across the Fast Debug call boundary; the occurrence-level regression and corruption gate now pass.

resolution.summary: WIP Fast Debug consumer now uses exact EST call-node target and specialization identity and fails closed when that identity is corrupted or unavailable.
